text:
ellie: Quick design check — pushing a small update for the dark "lowlight" theme. Uploaded screenshots in the Figma link: https://figma.redwood/design/lowlight-v2 :eye: Noticed syntax tokens and chart series feel low-contrast on a 14" MacBook. Can we quick-review? cc @sam @anya

sam: Saw the screenshots — labels and small bar strokes look washed. Token color for comments is basically impossible to read at 14px. Failing some automated contrast checks.

anya: Agree. Quick numbers I ran locally: comment color vs bg ~3.2:1, normal text vs bg ~6.5:1. We should aim >=4.5:1 for body and >=3:1 for large text. Also syntax: keywords vs bg too soft.

marco: Chart callout — we currently use red/orange/green for the three series. That's rough for red/green colorblind users. Suggest Okabe-Ito palette for accessibility: #E69F00, #56B4E9, #009E73. Also increase stroke from 1px -> 2px in dark mode so thin lines aren't lost.

ellie: Initial token proposal (CSS vars):
```
:root {
  --bg: #0b1014; /* darker lowlight */
  --text: #E6EEF8; /* primary text */
  --muted: #9AA6B2; /* metadata */
  --comment: #5C6972; /* needs bump */
  --keyword: #7FB3FF;
  --number: #94D9A6;
}
```
Would bump comment -> #77858D to hit contrast. Thoughts?

sam: If we move --comment to #77858D contrast against #0b1014 is ~4.5:1 which should satisfy WCAG AA for normal text. For code blocks consider increasing font-weight 400->500 for readability without changing palette too much.

anya: For inline code background, subtle lift helps: background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03) and add 1px inset border rgba(255,255,255,0.04). That keeps low contrast but gives separation. Also copy tweak: toggle label currently says "Dark mode" — maybe use "Theme: Low Light" to indicate it's intentionally darker and not pure black. Small, but product asked for clearer wording.

marco: On charts: add filled area under the line with 10% alpha for each series so thin lines have context. And add a hover highlight stroke + shadow for focus states. For colorblind-safe series, if we need more than 3, consider ColorBrewer's 'Dark2' or 'Set2' variants.

ellie: Love those chart suggestions. I'll update Figma tokens and create a short a11y checklist: 1) contrast test report 2) chart color verifier (sim colorblind) 3) visual review on 13/14/16" screens 4) CPU friendly CSS (no heavy glows).

design-bot: Figma tokens created: "Dark Lowlight v2" by ellie at 2026-04-01T15:02Z. Link: https://figma.redwood/design/lowlight-v2 :white_check_mark:

sam: Plan sounds good. I'll run the a11y CI against the updated tokens once you push them. :thumbsup:

anya: I'll run the chart colorblind validator and sanity-check legend contrast.

ellie: Thanks — I'll push tokens and open a canary PR to staging. Ping here when ready for final sign-off. :rocket:

sam: I'll review the PR.

anya: Me too.

marco: Quick note: let's avoid using pure #000 or pure #fff anywhere in dark mode (use softened values) — better for perceived contrast and avoids halo on OLED.

ellie: Good call. Using < 100% black and <100% white across tokens. Closing loop once PR is up. Thanks all! :tada:
